title: Workstations, sitting and the user
intro: Design a workstation around the user, task and relationships between chair, surface, screen and tools, then document a user trial and dimension sources.
goals: Test chair, surface and screen together
Record the trial and dimension sources

sections.title: Start with user and task
sections.text: Record tasks such as typing, paper work, calls and presenting, including devices, paper sizes and user-reported frequency. Separate frequently used tools from less-used storage and map reach relationships. One person’s station should not automatically become the team-wide solution.
sections.caption: Tasks define tools and access relationships.

sections.title: Test chair, surface and screen together
sections.text: Draw chair, surface, screen and leg relationships in section and input devices/paper in plan. Trial reach and movement with the user and review adjustment features under product instructions. Do not prescribe one height/distance for everyone or present the trial as medical diagnosis or treatment.
sections.caption: Review relationships with the actual user and products.

sections.title: Record the trial and dimension sources
sections.text: Record user, task, products and the source of each dimension: site measurement, product data or a trial assumption. Compare alternatives with the same task and log observation, change and acceptance. Recheck affected relationships after changing chair or device.
sections.caption: Measurements, assumptions and product data are different sources.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A screen base occupies the needed paper area in A. B uses a compatible arm to free it, but introduces mounting requirements. Review screen/arm/surface compatibility and repeat the user task before accepting B.
example.decision: Decision: improve the task while verifying product compatibility.

quiz.question: What supports workstation acceptance?
options: Documented task trial and product data
quiz.explanation: Acceptance connects tasks, system relationships and dimension sources.

assignment.prompt: Submit a user/task card, workstation plan/section, comparison trial and dimension-source register.
fields: Test chair, surface and screen together
Record the trial and dimension sources

faq.question: Do common dimensions validate a workstation?
faq.answer: No. Review the actual user, task, products and site.
